summary.value: The Tokyo and Kyoto schools hold their annual goodwill event, a two-day contest of team and one-on-one fights. Itadori, believed dead by his classmates, returns for it and old rivalries come out in the open.
Partway through, curses sent by Mahito's allies break into the venue and the contest turns into a fight to protect the school.

events.title: Itadori returns
events.detail: Gojo reveals that he is alive, and Megumi and Nobara have to take it in.

events.title: The team battle begins
events.detail: Tokyo and Kyoto split into teams for the first day of the event.

events.title: Curses invade the venue
events.detail: A curtain goes up over the school and curse users and spirits move in.

events.title: A special grade appears
events.detail: A special grade curse joins the attack and the rivals have to fight on the same side.
